title: Recovery of Recent Annual Reward Certificates on Cancellation
content:
**Clause.** When a membership of Northgate Memberships is cancelled for a refund, a year-end Annual Reward certificate issued no more than 60 days before the cancellation is recovered at its full value, one issued 61 to 120 days before is recovered at half its value rounded to the cent, and an older certificate or none is not recovered. The amount recovered is taken off the cancellation refund, which never goes below zero.

**Which certificate.** The latest year-end Annual Reward certificate issued on the membership, by issue date. Days are calendar days from the certificate's issue date to the cancellation date.

| Days from the latest certificate's issue date to the cancellation | Recovered |
|---|---|
| 60 or fewer | the certificate's full value |
| 61 to 120 | half the certificate's value, rounded to the cent |
| more than 120, or no certificate | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; certificate of 23.46 issued 31 December 2026)

| Cancellation date | Days | Recovered |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2027 | 60 | 23.46 |
| 2 March 2027 | 61 | half of 23.46 is 11.73 |
| 30 April 2027 | 120 | 11.73 |
| 1 May 2027 | 121 | nothing |
